natural_language_query: Show all customers from Mumbai
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai'

natural_language_query: List all products in Electronics category
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

natural_language_query: Show orders with pending status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

natural_language_query: Count orders by status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

natural_language_query: What is total revenue per product category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

natural_language_query: Average rating per product
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(CAST(rating AS FLOAT)) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id

natural_language_query: Top 5 customers by total amount spent
ground_truth_sql: SELECT TOP 5 c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY spent DESC

natural_language_query: Total number of orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

natural_language_query: List orders with customer names
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

natural_language_query: Show products with their order quantities
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name

natural_language_query: Orders with payment method paypal
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_method = 'paypal'

natural_language_query: Customers who bought Electronics
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'

natural_language_query: Orders in last 30 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

natural_language_query: Customers who signed up last year
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATEADD(YEAR, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

natural_language_query: What were top 10 products by revenue last quarter?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATEADD(MONTH, -3, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

natural_language_query: Payments in last 7 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

natural_language_query: Show revenue by month (ambiguous - should use orders.total_amount)
ground_truth_sql: SELECT FORMAT(order_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY FORMAT(order_date, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY month

natural_language_query: What is total collected payment amount?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS collected FROM payments WHERE status = 'success'

natural_language_query: List customers from Bangalore with their order count
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Bangalore' GROUP BY c.name

natural_language_query: Products with low stock less than 10
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 10

natural_language_query: Orders completed in last 60 days with total amount
ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -60, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

natural_language_query: Average order value by city
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city

natural_language_query: Top 3 most reviewed products
ground_truth_sql: SELECT TOP 3 product_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY review_count DESC, product_id

natural_language_query: Show customer email and city for customers who ordered in last 30 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.email, c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

natural_language_query: Count of successful payments by method
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments WHERE status = 'success' GROUP BY payment_method
